weeks.title: Week 1: Partnership Formation & Capital Accounts
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 1: Partnership Formation & Capital Accounts

Learning Objectives

  • Record partner contributions at FMV
  • Establish initial capital account balances
  • Apply profit/loss sharing agreements (ratios, salaries, interest)

Key Topics

1. Contribution of assets

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Contribution of assets. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Contribution of assets concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Contribution of assets is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

2. Capital account balances

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Capital account balances. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Capital account balances concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Capital account balances is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

3. Profit/loss sharing ratios

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Profit/loss sharing ratios. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Profit/loss sharing ratios concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Profit/loss sharing ratios is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

Practice Application

Work through practice problems applying week 1: partnership formation & capital accounts concepts. These problems mirror actual CPA exam scenarios and real-world CFO challenges.

Key Takeaways

  • Master Contribution of assets for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Capital account balances for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Profit/loss sharing ratios for exam success and professional competence
  • Understand authoritative guidance and when to apply it
  • Practice computational problems until you can solve them efficiently
  • Connect concepts to real-world CFO responsibilities

weeks.title: Week 2: Special Allocations & Distributions
weeks.lessonHtml:

weeks.title: Week 3: Partner Basis & At-Risk Rules
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 3: Partner Basis & At-Risk Rules

Learning Objectives

  • Calculate partner's outside basis (contributions + income - distributions)
  • Allocate partnership debt to partners for basis
  • Apply at-risk rules to limit loss deductions

weeks.title: Week 4: Partnership Liquidations
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 4: Partnership Liquidations

Learning Objectives

  • Prepare schedule of partnership liquidation
  • Calculate safe payments to partners (installment method)
  • Use LAP to determine distribution priorities
